account: In 2023 a car driving north from Mexico approached the Point of Entry at San Ysidro. A U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) machine-learning model identified a suspicious pattern in its border-crossing history and flagged it for review. DHS chief information officer Eric Hysen described the event in congressional testimony on September 14, 2023. An alert generated in under 1.4 seconds prompted an officer to refer the car to secondary inspection. Officers found over 75 kilograms of narcotics in the rear quarter panels and gas tank, seized the drugs and vehicle, and arrested the driver and passenger. At the Axios AI+ Summit on 28 November 2023 Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas described a matching case. The Office of Field Operations model flagged a “truck” in 1.4 seconds that held about 75 kilograms of narcotics. DHS's 2024 AI Roadmap repeats it: a secondary-review flag yielding over 75 kg of drugs. No source names the drug or the seizure date.

ai_role.statement: The model's contribution was the referral. DHS says it identified a suspicious pattern in the car's border-crossing history and flagged it for review. Mayorkas said the anomaly was identified in 1.4 seconds. The discovery of the narcotics and the arrest were done by officers in secondary review. No source states whether the car would have been referred without the flag. The model's counterfactual contribution is thus asserted by DHS, not demonstrated. The Monitor entry also bundles Mayorkas's claim that AI age-progression imagery has recovered abducted children. That claim names no case, date, or child.

fields.account: In 2023 a car driving north from Mexico approached the Point of Entry at San Ysidro. A U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) machine-learning model identified a suspicious pattern in its border-crossing history and flagged it for review. DHS chief information officer Eric Hysen described the event in congressional testimony on September 14, 2023. An alert generated in under 1.4 seconds prompted an officer to refer the car to secondary inspection. Officers found over 75 kilograms of narcotics in the rear quarter panels and gas tank, seized the drugs and vehicle, and arrested the driver and passenger. At the Axios AI+ Summit on 28 November 2023 Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas described a matching case. The Office of Field Operations model flagged a “truck” in 1.4 seconds that held about 75 kilograms of narcotics. DHS's 2024 AI Roadmap repeats it: a secondary-review flag yielding over 75 kg of drugs. No source names the drug or the seizure date.
